positions.notes: BRIEF §1: one name for CATEGORY_LABELS.ru.historic and cat.historic.t. Chose the published «Исторические достопримечательности» over «Исторические места»: it renders the new source «المعالم التاريخية / Historic landmarks» exactly, is the plural of the verified kicker «Историческая достопримечательность» (معلم تاريخي), and is already what foot.l.historic and the home card carry. «Исторические места» is vaguer (any historical place) and was the weaker of the two. Distinct from the section name «Достопримечательности» by its adjective, mirroring ar «المعالم» vs «المعالم التاريخية». cat.historic.t (ui.ts 1088) already equals it — no edit there. Length: 34 chars vs 19, shown as detail-hero eyebrow (.ah-k), listing card kicker (.lc-k), section heading on /ru/attractions/ and footer link — wrap check after apply.

BRIEF §1: the card opens the nature category only; copied CATEGORY_LABELS.ru.nature «Природа» verbatim (= ar «الطبيعة», en «Nature»). cat.nature.d unchanged (mountains, caves, palm groves — no farms claim).

BRIEF §4 owner ruling (2026-10-04) overrides the termbase measured split «Что увидеть» (entry «UI nav label: Attractions (top bar)»). Now identical to crumb.attractions, so header, breadcrumb and list.title agree. Width: measured 2026-09-05 at 181,2px vs 82px (+99,2px) in the compressed header block — run tools/measure-header-fit.mjs after apply; this is the main risk of the batch.

BRIEF §3/§4: column now holds only site matters (Правила и условия использования, Сообщить об ошибке, Свяжитесь с нами, WhatsApp). «О сайте» is the standard Russian footer heading for this group and the blind reader’s own proposal; bare «Сайт» read as a noun label, not a heading. Short (7 chars), no width risk.
